proofs: Task diagnostics compose six existing authenticated bounded read operations. No new wire command, transport, permission, administrative fallback or Store shortcut is introduced. Task identity and current authority are checked again at the final read.

A scoped Native grant sees Waiting, source references and original journal cursor. Unauthorized optional owner-reply and process-health views are explicitly unavailable. Whole authoritative Store equality proves reads do not consume or mutate.

Close the diagnostic client, submit an exact attributed human reply, reopen and catch up from the saved journal cursor: original task is Ready and the reply remains unconsumed. No notification consumer supplies the result.
Revoking the original grant denies a subsequent diagnostic sample; wrong-task access, invalid limit and cross-view cursor are rejected without Store mutation.
An authorized owner sees unassigned reply metadata and explicit recall omissions under a one-item page limit. Separate cursors do not infer global completion.

A separately executed CLI uses the protected exported Native configuration and public SDK. Serialized reports exclude tested question/answer bodies and credentials. The closed projection also removes arbitrary terminal/provider error and effect-outcome text while retaining reconciliation identities and historical uncertainty state.

Actual owned TCP listeners publish abort-before-first-poll failure and wake runtime supervision. Normal auxiliary teardown preserves the primary endpoint; primary teardown/drop reports stopped. Cancelling a pending shutdown retains abort ownership and closes the listener instead of detaching it.

Legacy configured readiness observations retain their serialized shape. Explicit unconfigured optional MCP does not degrade configured native components; no configured observation remains uncertain. Worker failure remains unavailable.

Python and TypeScript retain legacy health compatibility, preserve both boolean configured values and reject null, numeric, string, object and array substitutes. The TypeScript public type exposes the optional flag; generated modules are rebuilt and all 149 Node and 21 Python SDK tests pass.

Fourteen existing MCP/native grant regressions pass for actual authentication, wrong origin/binding, oversized-body policy, cancellation, expiry/revocation, startup failure/retry and independent discovery/communication.

code_review.boundaries: Public composition stays in connect-client; server CLI uses only that API. Protocol owns additive readiness shape; service owns aggregate state; MCP owns its listener supervision. Store is a dev-only MCP fixture dependency.
code_review.production_modules: New focused production modules contain 43–139 lines and public Rustdoc. No examples access server SQLite.
code_review.sampling: One page per independent lane, limits 1–100, no atomic snapshot claim; changed task revision is explicit. Historical effect events are not current delivery receipts.
code_review.warning: The existing macOS debug linker unwind warning is retained. Strict Rust Clippy, Rustdoc and repository formatting pass.
